sentences.heading: Disciplines
sentences.sentence: The deterministic compiler SHALL be authoritative for rule facts, legality and history; model output and pixels SHALL NOT originate them.

sentences.heading: Disciplines
sentences.sentence: Every `GameRecord` SHALL carry a `source` and a `history_complete` assertion made by the trusted source; unknown history SHALL NOT be invented; a four-field FEN source SHALL NOT yield `history_complete: true`.

sentences.heading: Disciplines
sentences.sentence: A failure SHALL be reported, never silently repaired: unparseable notation, observation/ledger mismatch, illegal model move.

sentences.heading: Disciplines
sentences.sentence: An engine MAY supply teacher labels or post-decision scoring, or play as an opponent; the model's inference path SHALL NOT query an engine.

sentences.heading: Disciplines
sentences.sentence: Ability SHALL be reported per scoring axis with bounded evidence; a composite winner score SHALL NOT be produced.

sentences.heading: Disciplines
sentences.sentence: Free prose SHALL NOT be scored; only mechanically checkable structured claims.

sentences.heading: Technology pins
sentences.sentence: Viewer: Leptos 0.8.x + axum, compiled to WASM; the application SHALL contain no JavaScript or TypeScript.

sentences.heading: Technology pins
sentences.sentence: A Tauri desktop shell MAY wrap the same viewer later.
